//require-dev: PHPUnit is pinned to 9.x on purpose. WordPress's test harness (wp-phpunit) calls PHPUnit\Util\Test::parseTestMethodAnnotations(), which PHPUnit 10 removed — so PHPUnit 10/11 fails every integration test with 'undefined method'. wp-phpunit declares no PHPUnit constraint of its own, so Composer will happily install an incompatible version if this is loosened. 9.6 + polyfills 2.x is the pairing WordPress core itself uses.
